title: 3 cities in one day

title: Unexpected

title: Rain, magnificent landscapes, and a top-notch Julio! 😄
text:
I had an excellent day on this excursion discovering Cordoba, Setenil, and Ronda! Despite some fickle weather, this experience was a real success thanks to our guide Julio. Passionate, friendly, and very professional, he knew how to make each stop interesting and enriching. I learned a lot throughout the day and I really appreciated his explanations and his good humor.

A big thank you to Julio for this beautiful experience! I highly recommend this excursion!
author: corentineo2025
